column1: # LBCH-2026-001 fix witness — per-vector sigCheck deltas from the CHECKMULTISIG Schnorr billing fix.
# Every vector whose LeanBCH signatureCheckCount MOVED, over the 11 signature families of the
# official BCH vmb_test corpus (5,803 vectors; 4,467 reach a comparable metric total).
#          leanbch = ./.lake/build/bin/costprobe, LEANBCH_SECP=native, this commit vs parent a8b7682
#                    committed 0u4tu8 witness (libauth sigChecks 1, hashIters 22: reproduced exactly).
# Direction: sigChecksAfter <= sigChecksBefore on EVERY vector (0 increases corpus-wide).
# stackPushedBytes) and all verdicts are UNCHANGED on all 4,467 vectors.
# NOTE on libauthSigChecks: this is libauth's WHOLE-INPUT total. Where it exceeds LeanBCH's by a
# wide margin the cause is the still-DEFERRED Schnorr-multisig execution branch
# (LeanBCH/VM/Extended.lean:228): LeanBCH errors at the first Schnorr CHECKMULTISIG and never
# executes the input's remaining signature ops, so their checks are never billed. All 216 vectors
# whose libauth-relative under-bill DEEPENED are vectors LeanBCH REJECTS for that reason.
